harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: On node1 (CentOS Stream 10), built a local package repository from packages downloaded to local storage, served it via a systemd-managed HTTP server on NODE_IP, made the real remote mirror network-unreachable and disabled the remote repo configs, then installed the "tree" package purely from the local HTTP-served repo. Restored remote reachability afterward. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured baseline boot identity and service/package health, rebooted node1, confirmed the boot identity changed, and verified the package and local repo recovered post-restart.
actions_performed: Inspected node1: CentOS Stream 10, dnf4, no local ISO/RPM cache, remote repos reachable via mirrors.centos.org metalink
Installed createrepo_c and dnf-plugins-core from remote repos while still reachable
Downloaded tree-2.1.0-8.el10.x86_64.rpm into local storage at /opt/localrepo/pkgs
Ran createrepo_c to build repo metadata from local storage
Served the repo via a systemd-run transient unit localrepo-http.service (python3 http.server bound to NODE_IP:8080)
Created /etc/yum.repos.d/local.repo pointing at http://$NODE_IP:8080/
Backed up original repo files and /etc/hosts, blackholed mirrors.centos.org via /etc/hosts, disabled centos.repo/centos-addons.repo, confirmed remote unreachability via curl timeout (exit 28)
Installed tree via dnf using only the local repo; confirmed transaction listed repository 'local'
Restored /etc/hosts and original remote repo files; verified remote reachability and repolist restored
Captured baseline boot_id and confirmed local repo service + tree package healthy
Scheduled and executed a reboot of node1 via systemd-run deferred systemctl reboot
Polled node1 until reachable again and confirmed boot_id changed (96974ac3... -> 00c3860a...)
Verified post-restart: tree package still installed, local repo files intact on disk, re-started the transient HTTP service and confirmed it serves the repo metadata again

evidence.requirement: Local package repository served from local storage on node1
evidence.summary: Confirmed no pre-existing local package cache, downloaded tree RPM into /opt/localrepo/pkgs, ran createrepo_c to build metadata, and served the directory via a systemd unit on NODE_IP:8080 with a successful curl fetch of repodata/repomd.xml
curl to https://mirrors.centos.org/ returned exit code 28 (connection timed out) after /etc/hosts was pointed to a non-routable TEST-NET address, and remote repo files were disabled

evidence.requirement: Package installed from the local repo while remote unreachable
evidence.summary: With only the 'local' repo enabled (remote repos disabled and network-blocked), dnf installed tree; transaction output shows Repository: local, and rpm -q / tree --version confirm successful installation

evidence.requirement: Node restored to normal state after demonstration
evidence.summary: Removed the /etc/hosts blackhole entry, restored original remote repo files (enabled=1), verified curl to mirrors.centos.org succeeds again and dnf repolist shows both remote and local repos
Captured boot_id 96974ac3-f19e-45f7-9672-e880dd505cf8, confirmed localrepo-http.service active, local repo HTTP endpoint healthy, and tree package installed with working binary

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart acknowledgement and boot identity change
evidence.summary: Deferred reboot scheduled and acknowledged, timer fired confirmed via systemctl status, node became unreachable during reboot (connection timeout/reset), then came back with boot_id 00c3860a-e564-4d38-a5ae-e9c30a0b4c7d (changed from baseline) and a fresh uptime -s timestamp of 2026-09-29 08:14:34

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of required services and data on node1
evidence.summary: After reboot, tree package and binary still present, local repo files and metadata intact on disk, transient HTTP service (expected not to persist across reboot) was re-started and confirmed serving repodata/repomd.xml again, and dnf repolist shows the local repo available
